correctbench_cross_domain.interpretation: supports abstract instrument-applicability control, but source exposure before a new freeze prevents prospective transfer credit

toolbenchx_v09.common_cause_observation: Near-chain-wide TimeoutError patterns in two unresolved cases; independent retry fan-out spent calls and recovered no terminal answer.

bounded_fresh_remainder_census.boundary: explicitly bounded fresh eligible AtCoder remainder only; not benchmark-wide prevalence

not_supported: AVR improves GPT-5.6 by a stated percentage
the ToolBench-X controller results are matched independent GPT-5.6 model results
the verifier-contract mismatch rate generalizes benchmark-wide
supported: measured controller effects on explicitly identified bounded experiments
prompt/state binding showed a positive causal signal in the 10-case ToolBench-X v0.9 controller ablation
verifier-contract validation prospectively prevented invalid exact-scoring assumptions on multiple fresh AtCoder tasks

conditional_only.condition: only after a concrete externally verified failure signal; fresh re-verification required
only for a classified transient failure; no unchanged retry after deterministic schema/type/permission failure
only when a material unresolved assumption has one concrete plausible alternative that changes action and no direct discriminator already settles it

interpretation.deliberation_interpretation: Additional same-model deliberation without new evidence is not progress and has no default role.
interpretation.recovery_interpretation: Recovery is not part of the unconditional minimal path. It is an exception mechanism triggered by an observed, classified, externally checkable failure.
interpretation.semantic_gate_interpretation: A correct model output cannot yield claim-grade evidence when the scoring instrument is semantically inapplicable; such cases must be quarantined rather than counted as model failures.
interpretation.strongest_current_thesis: Bind the actual task/state and required evidence first; use external falsifiable capability only for a real deficit; validate the measurement/verifier contract; commit once evidence is complete enough; stop.

next_gate.fallback_if_no_clean_domain_is_available: Do not manufacture a transfer result; retain AtCoder-bounded status and stop.
requirements: new domain/source whose task/verifier semantics have not been opened before sample freeze
freeze task set and abstract mismatch taxonomy before case inspection
no hidden labels/oracle leakage before classification
zero false quarantines on the frozen sample
at least one real prospectively detected applicability mismatch for positive transfer evidence
